title: Single-cell proteome atlas of aging mouse microglia reveals subpopulation-specific phagoproteome
title_zh: 老化小鼠小胶质细胞单细胞蛋白组图谱揭示亚群特异性吞噬蛋白组
abstract: Microglia are brain-resident immune cells with complex physiological functions. Exploring their proteomic heterogeneity at the single-cell level has remained technically challenging. Here, we optimized a label-free single-cell proteomics (SCP) workflow using Orbitrap Astral mass spectrometry (MS) and applied it to fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS)-sorted microglia from the hippocampus and prefrontal cortex of young, middle-aged, and aged mice. This yielded one of the largest SCP datasets to date, comprising 3,085 single cells, with an average of 1,153 protein groups identified per cell. Compared with single-cell transcriptomic data, the SCP dataset showed higher expression completeness and moderate cross-modality correlation. This dataset revealed spatiotemporal proteomic heterogeneity of microglia during aging. Notably, we defined the microglial "phagoproteome," uncovering state-specific phagocytic preferences, and verified these results by imaging. This study underscores the potential of SCP to reveal subpopulation-specific proteomic dynamics and provides a new resource for studying microglial state transitions during aging.
abstract_zh: 小胶质细胞是脑内常驻免疫细胞，具有复杂的生理功能，但在单细胞水平探索其蛋白组异质性一直技术上困难。我们优化了基于无标记单细胞蛋白组学（SCP）的工作流，使用Orbitrap Astral质谱（MS），并将其应用于荧光激活细胞分选（FACS）富集的海马和前额叶皮层年轻、中年与老年小鼠小胶质细胞。该方法获得了截至目前规模最大的SCP数据集之一，包含3,085个单细胞，平均每细胞鉴定1,153个蛋白组分。与单细胞转录组相比，SCP数据集显示更高的表达完整性和中等水平的跨模态相关性。该数据揭示了衰老过程中小胶质细胞时空蛋白组异质性。值得注意的是，我们定义了小胶质细胞“phagoproteome”，揭示了状态特异性的吞噬偏好，并通过成像方法验证了这些结果。本研究强调SCP揭示亚群特异性蛋白组动力学的潜力，并为研究老化期间小胶质细胞状态转换提供了新资源。
